unterminated_string.title: unterminated string
unterminated_string.help: did you forget a closing quote?

unexpected_token.title: unexpected token
unexpected_token.help: this token is not valid here; check for a missing delimiter or keyword before it

expected_token.title: expected a different token
expected_token.help: the parser expected a specific token here; verify punctuation and keywords

unclosed_delimiter.title: unclosed delimiter
unclosed_delimiter.help: a '(' '[' or '{' was opened but not closed on this path

trailing_or_extra_token.title: trailing or extra token
trailing_or_extra_token.help: remove extra punctuation or a stray comma at the end of the list

invalid_assignment_target.title: invalid assignment target
invalid_assignment_target.help: only names, tuple patterns, or index/field targets may appear on the left of an assignment

undefined_name.title: undefined name
undefined_name.help: this name is not defined in the current scope

arity_mismatch.title: arity mismatch in grouped binding
arity_mismatch.help: the number of names on the left must equal the number of values on the right

redeclared_symbol.title: name already defined in this scope
redeclared_symbol.help: choose a different name or remove the earlier declaration

type_mismatch.title: type mismatch
type_mismatch.help: the expression does not have the expected type

wrong_return_kind.title: return type mismatch
wrong_return_kind.help: the returned expression does not match the function's declared return type

assign_to_immutable.title: cannot assign to immutable variable
assign_to_immutable.help: declare the variable with 'mut' if you intend to reassign it

not_public.title: symbol is not public
not_public.help: symbols imported from another module must be declared with 'pub'

public_const_not_const.title: public constant must be compile-time constant
public_const_not_const.help: public constants must be literal compile-time values

pub_let_mut_forbidden.title: public let cannot be mutable
pub_let_mut_forbidden.help: remove 'mut' from public top-level let declarations

import_cycle.title: import cycle
import_cycle.help: break the cycle by removing or refactoring one of the imports

missing_module.title: cannot find module
missing_module.help: verify the dotted path and ensure the file exists under a search root (project dir or compiler/lib)

duplicate_import.title: duplicate import
duplicate_import.help: remove the repeated import; importing the same module multiple times has no effect

unused_variable.title: unused variable or parameter
unused_variable.help: Prefix the name with '_' to silence this warning.

missing_explicit_return.title: function may fall through without an explicit return
